Pays USDC on Base (stablestudio also Solana/Tempo via mpp). No API key. Verified job id this run: cmq8sn2ty000204l7mgs0umpc.

CAPABILITY: image input is REFERENCE-ONLY (input_reference) — conditions style/content but does NOT guarantee a specific FIRST or LAST/ending frame. Do NOT claim the output ends on a given image. entries.description: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Fast — faster, lower-cost Seedance video generation.

usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance-fast/i2v with JSON body {prompt, imageUrl} (x402 USDC on Base; optional duration, aspectRatio, outputResolution). Returns {jobId, status:"pending"}; poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX (free) until status=complete.
usage.outputShape: Generate call: body.jobId, body.status. Poll call (GET /api/jobs/{jobId}): body.status (pending|loading|complete), body.progress, and on completion body.result.videoUrl + body.result.thumbnailUrl.
quirks: OVER-CAP: the i2v backend quotes a flat $20 USDC regardless of body params (tested minimal {prompt,imageUrl} and full {duration,aspectRatio,outputResolution:480p} — both quoted exactly $20). This exceeds a $10 per-call ceiling, so it was NOT paid/verified.
i2v is image-to-video — requires an input image (imageUrl) in addition to the prompt; bare {prompt} alone is for the t2v sibling backend.
PRICING DIVERGES FROM t2v: the t2v sibling (seedance-2-0-fast#1) verified at ~$0.84/clip, but this i2v backend's base quote is $20 — much higher. Guard your ceiling accordingly.
ASYNC (inherited from t2v behavior): the paid POST is expected to return {jobId, status:'pending'} immediately, NOT the video. You must poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId}.
POLL AUTH IS SIWX, NOT PAYMENT: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} requires a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header (free, same wallet that paid). qa-pay --siwx handles it.
RESULT URLs EXPIRE in ~20 minutes — download videoUrl/thumbnailUrl immediately after completion (per t2v behavior).
Do NOT resubmit while status is pending/loading — duplicate submits create duplicate PAID jobs.
usage.guide: Image-to-video via ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Fast. POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance-fast/i2v with JSON {"prompt":"...","imageUrl":"<source image URL>"} paying x402 USDC on Base. The response is expected to be an async job {jobId, status:"pending"}, not the video; poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header (free, same wallet) every ~15-20s until status=="complete", then read body.result.videoUrl and download immediately (URLs expire ~20 min). Never resubmit a pending job.

`mode` enum: 'keyframe' (default; treats first image as a starting keyframe) or 'reference' (reference-guided). `urlMediaTypes` is one 'image'|'video' per urls entry aligned by index; recommended for clarity though StableStudio also infers it from URL content-type before charging.
Optional `audioUrls` (max 3 public audio URLs) for audio-guided generation; optional `resolution` exact-pixel override; optional upscaleResolution:'4k'.
duration STRING enum '4'..'15'; outputResolution '480p'/'720p'/'1080p'; aspectRatio 1:1/3:4/4:3/16:9/9:16/21:9.

Prefer Base; treat a 'Settlement failed' 500 as a payment-network issue, not a bad request, and retry.

Result polling is FREE via Sign-In-With-X (same wallet that paid) — do NOT treat polling as a paid/metered cost. Poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} until status="complete".

Poll status lifecycle: submit returns status="pending"; while rendering the poll returns status="loading" with a numeric progress (0-100); on finish status="complete" with result.videoUrl + result.thumbnailUrl (Vercel blob mp4). Verified live 2026-06-23.

entries.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
entries.description: ByteDance Seedance 1.5 Pro — high-quality video generation.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON body {model, prompt}
usage.outputShape: Submit response: body.id (job id), body.status ("queued"), body.payment_status ("verified"), body.poll_url (relative path with signed sig). Final video URL is returned by the completed poll response (GET poll_url) — not in the submit response.
quirks: Async two-step: POST submits a job (202, status:queued), result is NOT in the submit response.
Poll via the returned body.poll_url (relative path, prepend https://blockrun.ai). Each poll is a SEPARATE x402-paid request — it returns its own 402 challenge and must be re-signed.
The poll request MUST be signed by the SAME wallet that submitted the POST (wallet-bound; a fresh signature is fine, byte-equality not required).
On the first poll where status becomes 'completed', the server settles and returns the video URL. Status progresses queued -> in_progress -> completed. Typical generation 60-180s.
Actual cost was $0.459, not the $0.150 registry surface — price scales with video duration (default 5s, duration_seconds:5). payment.accepts amount was 420001 (~$0.42), but settled quote was $0.459.
Polling costs money per poll (jobIdPath=jobId in registry but actual field is body.id; submit response uses body.id not jobId).
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON {model:"bytedance/seedance-1.5-pro", prompt:"..."} using an x402 client (USDC on Base). You get a 202 with a queued job: read body.id and body.poll_url. To get the video, GET https://blockrun.ai + body.poll_url with an x402 payment header signed by the same wallet — this poll is itself paid and returns a 402 challenge if unsigned. Repeat the paid poll every ~20-30s until status is "completed"; the completed poll response contains the final video URL. Budget for the submit cost (~$0.46 for 5s) plus per-poll costs.

entries.name: Grok Imagine Video
entries.description: Generate a short AI video from a text prompt (and optional reference image) using xAI's Grok Imagine video model. Multi-gateway: same Grok Imagine video op available via StableStudio (default, cheapest, async), BlockRun (job gateway, multi-model), and Xona (synchronous, Base proxy of a Solana service).

usage.callShape: DEFAULT (StableStudio): POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/grok-video/generate with JSON {prompt, duration?, resolution?, aspect_ratio?, image?} (x402 ~$0.15 USDC on Base). Returns 200 {success, jobId, status:'pending', type}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX-signed, FREE, same wallet) until status='complete' to get the video URL. ALT BlockRun: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with {model:'xai/grok-imagine-video', prompt, image_url?, duration_seconds?} (x402 ~$0.42). ALT Xona: POST https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/video/short-generation with {prompt, aspect_ratio?, image_url?} (x402 ~$0.50) — SYNCHRONOUS, returns {video_url, duration, model, metadata} directly (fixed 10s clip).
usage.outputShape: DEFAULT/StableStudio (POST): success(bool), jobId(string), status('pending'), type('grok-video-generate'); poll /api/jobs/{jobId} then yields completed status + video URL. Xona (synchronous): video_url(string,CDN), duration(number, always 10), model(string), metadata(object: request_id, aspect_ratio, ...). BlockRun: job-submission response (async job id).
quirks: MULTI-GATEWAY same op, but per-gateway field names DIFFER — do not reuse one body across gateways.

StableStudio (default): body fields are prompt, duration (enum strings '3'/'6'/'9'/'12'/'15', NOT ints; default '6'), resolution ('480p'/'720p', default '720p'), aspect_ratio ('1:1'/'16:9'/'9:16'/'4:3'/'3:4'/'3:2'/'2:3', default '16:9'), optional image (uri) for image-to-video. Only prompt is required (others have defaults). additionalProperties:false.
StableStudio is ASYNC: POST charges ~$0.15 once and returns a PENDING jobId (NOT the video). Must poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} to get the result.

StableStudio poll endpoint is SIWX-gated (returns 402 'SIWX authentication required', amount=0) — polling is FREE but requires a wallet SIWX signature from the SAME wallet that paid. qa-pay --siwx works; a cross-wallet client returns 403/Unauthorized.
Generation is fast: a '3'-second 480p clip completed in ~28s in prior runs; larger duration/resolution is slower.

BlockRun field-name trap: requires model:'xai/grok-imagine-video' (it's a multi-model gateway, default is already grok), uses image_url (not image) and duration_seconds (integer 1-60, not the string 'duration' enum). prompt maxLength 4000.

Xona field-name trap: only prompt, aspect_ratio (string, no enum), image_url (image-to-video). NO duration field — output is a FIXED 10-second clip. Xona is SYNCHRONOUS (returns video_url directly, no polling).

Xona's published OpenAPI is on SOLANA (USDC on Solana) at path /video/short-generation; the registered Base rail URL adds a '/base-main' path prefix (Base-network proxy deployment) — keep the full registered URL.
POST on StableStudio also offered a Solana payment rail in accepts[]; Base USDC was used for verification.
CAPABILITY: image input is a single start/reference image — NOT a guaranteed last/ending frame. For first+last keyframe use Seedance 2 Pro i2v or CogVideoX.

entries.name: CogVideoX
entries.description: Z.AI CogVideoX-3 — text/image-to-video with optional AI sound effects, up to 4K, 5-10s.

usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/videos/generations with JSON body {model, prompt} (model required = "cogvideox-3"; prompt or image_url required). Returns 200 with an async job {id, task_status:"PROCESSING"}; then GET https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} (free, no payment) until task_status="SUCCESS".
usage.outputShape: Submit: body.id (job id), body.task_status ("PROCESSING"). Poll result: body.task_status ("SUCCESS"/"PROCESSING"/"FAIL"), final video at body.video_result[0].url (mp4), thumbnail at body.video_result[0].cover_image_url.
quirks: Async two-step: the paid POST only QUEUES the job and returns task_status:PROCESSING — it does NOT return the video. You MUST poll to get the result.
Poll URL is GET {origin}/zai/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} using the id from the submit response. Polling is FREE (no x402 payment).

Completion took ~20 polls (roughly 2-3 minutes); poll every ~6-8s, allow up to 40 polls. While pending the poll body is minimal {id, model, task_status:PROCESSING}; on SUCCESS it gains video_result[].
Read the final video from video_result[0].url (an mp4 on mfile.z.ai). The mp4 URL carries a watermark filename and may be time-limited — download promptly.
model field is required and must be 'cogvideox-3'. Either prompt or image_url must be supplied (prompt alone works).
Payment is single-charge at submit only ($0.01 on Base USDC); polling does not charge again.

Charge-then-error behavior: if the upstream Z.ai resource package is depleted, the gateway returns HTTP 429 code 1113 "insufficient balance/recharge" but STILL charges $0.01 (no result). Recovers when the operator tops up; an error response carries no job id (the engine surfaces provider_error, no phantom poll).
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/videos/generations with JSON {"model":"cogvideox-3","prompt":"<your scene>"} (pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402). You get back a job with an id and task_status:"PROCESSING" — this is async, the video is NOT in this response. Then repeatedly GET https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} (free) every ~6-8 seconds until task_status becomes "SUCCESS" (allow a few minutes / up to 40 polls). When successful, the video mp4 URL is at video_result[0].url and a cover image at video_result[0].cover_image_url. Optional params: quality ("speed"|"quality"), duration (5|10), fps (30|60), with_audio (bool), size, image_url[] for image-to-video.

entries.name: Wan 2.6 Text-to-Video
entries.description: Wan 2.6 text-to-video: generate a 5/10/15s video from a text prompt only (no image). Async job — POST returns a jobId, then poll the SIWX job endpoint for the finished video.

usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/wan-2.6/t2v with JSON body {prompt, size?, duration?, negativePrompt?, seed?, enablePromptExpansion?, multiShots?, audioUrl?}. Pay x402/MPP USDC on Base. Only 'prompt' is required. Returns {success, jobId, status:'pending', type:'wan-2.6-t2v'}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX, FREE) every ~15s until status='complete', read result.videoUrl.

inputExample.prompt: a red circle gently pulsing on a black background

usage.outputShape: success(bool=true), jobId(string), status(string='pending'), type(string='wan-2.6-t2v'). Final video via poll: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} -> result.videoUrl (Vercel Blob, expires ~20min).
quirks: FIELD-NAME TRAP: t2v uses 'size' (enum '1280*720'|'720*1280'|'1920*1080'|'1080*1920', star-separated WxH string, default '1280*720') — NOT 'resolution'. The i2v sibling is the one that uses 'resolution'. The old registry inputExample (resolution:'720p') was wrong for t2v.
TEXT-only: do NOT send an 'image' field; only 'prompt' is required (1-2000 chars).
duration is a STRING enum '5'|'10'|'15' (default '5'), not an integer.
Two-step async: POST returns only {jobId, status:'pending'}. The video is NOT in the POST response. Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} until status='complete'.
POLL IS SIWX, FREE (no USDC): GET /api/jobs/{jobId} needs a sign-in-with-X wallet signature; without it returns 402 with a siwx extension. agentcash fetch / --siwx handles it.
DYNAMIC PRICING: registry surface $10 is the cap; observed charge $0.50 for 5s/720p. x402+mpp on Base.
enablePromptExpansion defaults true server-side; multiShots requires prompt expansion.
Do NOT resubmit while a job is 'pending'/'loading' — duplicate submissions create duplicate paid jobs. Result videoUrl is a Vercel Blob URL that expires ~20min; download immediately.
Canonical origin is stablestudio.dev; the .io host serves the same API but is treated as an unverified/typosquat destination by payment guards — use .dev.
usage.guide: Wan 2.6 text-to-video: generate a 5/10/15s video from a text prompt only (no image). Async job — POST returns a jobId, then poll the SIWX job endpoint for the finished video. POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/wan-2.6/t2v with JSON body {prompt, size?, duration?, negativePrompt?, seed?, enablePromptExpansion?, multiShots?, audioUrl?}. Pay x402/MPP USDC on Base. Only 'prompt' is required. Returns {success, jobId, status:'pending', type:'wan-2.6-t2v'}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX, FREE) every ~15s until status='complete', read result.videoUrl. Output: success(bool=true), jobId(string), status(string='pending'), type(string='wan-2.6-t2v'). Final video via poll: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} -> result.videoUrl (Vercel Blob, expires ~20min).

usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/wan-2.6/i2v with JSON body {image, prompt, resolution?, duration?, negativePrompt?, seed?, enablePromptExpansion?, multiShots?, audioUrl?}. Pay x402/MPP USDC on Base. 'image' (source URL) AND 'prompt' (motion desc) are both required. Returns {success, jobId, status:'pending', type:'wan-2.6-i2v'}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX, FREE) every ~15s until status='complete', read result.videoUrl.

quirks: REQUIRES both 'image' (source image URL to animate) AND 'prompt' (motion/animation description). Unlike the t2v sibling which needs only a prompt.
FIELD-NAME TRAP: i2v uses 'resolution' (enum '720p'|'1080p', default '720p') — NOT 'size'. The t2v sibling is the one that uses 'size' (WxH star string).

IMAGE URL must be DIRECTLY fetchable. A Wikipedia thumbnail URL ('/wikipedia/commons/thumb/.../320px-...jpg') returned 400 {success:false, error:'Invalid image URL'} (NO charge, paid:false). A resolved fastly/picsum direct-JPEG URL worked. Avoid redirect-source URLs; pass the final resolved URL.
duration is a STRING enum '5'|'10'|'15' (default '5').
Two-step async: POST returns only {jobId, status:'pending'}. Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} until status='complete'.
POLL IS SIWX, FREE: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} needs a sign-in-with-X wallet signature; agentcash fetch / --siwx handles it.
DYNAMIC PRICING: registry surface $10 is the cap; observed charge $0.50 for 5s/720p. x402+mpp on Base.
Do NOT resubmit while 'pending' — duplicate paid jobs. videoUrl is a Vercel Blob URL expiring ~20min; download immediately.
Canonical origin is stablestudio.dev; the .io host serves the same API but is blocked by payment guards as a possible typosquat — use .dev.

entries.name: Kodo AI Video
entries.description: Kodo — AI creative toolkit for image & video generation.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.kodo.fun/v1/generate with JSON body {prompt}
usage.outputShape: body.results[].url (expected); ACTUAL on x402 wallet: body.generation.errorCode == "FORBIDDEN", body.generation.message == "Invalid account"
quirks: Field is `prompt`, NOT `positive` (sending {positive} returns 400 'Prompt is required' even though outputSchema shows params.positive).
Charge-then-reject: x402 payment settles on-chain (confirmed tx) but the service returns HTTP 200 with body {generation:{message:'Invalid account',errorCode:'FORBIDDEN'}} — no generation is produced.
Generation is gated behind a Kodo account the paying x402 wallet does not have; paying via x402 alone does NOT grant access. Do not call: money is lost with no result.
usage.guide: Do not call this endpoint with a pure x402 wallet — it is broken for agents. POST https://api.kodo.fun/v1/generate with {"prompt":"..."} accepts the x402 $0.02 payment and the tx confirms on Base, but the server responds HTTP 200 with {generation:{message:"Invalid account",errorCode:"FORBIDDEN"}} and produces nothing. The service gates generation behind a Kodo account/identity that the x402 payer wallet lacks, so payment is lost with no usable output. Skip until/unless an account-linking mechanism exists.

entries.name: Portal Foundation Video
entries.description: Portal Foundation — AI text-to-video generation.

usage.callShape: POST https://gen.portalfoundation.ai/api/generate-video with JSON body {prompt}
usage.outputShape: body.url (mp4 video URL); also body.model, body.duration, body.cost, body.success, body.paymentSettlement.transaction
quirks: Body field is `prompt` (text-to-video).
Synchronous: the paid 200 response directly contains the finished video URL at body.url (a Vercel blob .mp4) — no job id, no polling.
Flat $1.00 per call (x402 on Base USDC); generates a 5s Google Veo 3 Fast video.
Response echoes on-chain settlement at body.paymentSettlement.transaction.
usage.guide: Call POST https://gen.portalfoundation.ai/api/generate-video with JSON body {"prompt":"<your text prompt>"} and pay the x402 charge ($1.00 USDC on Base). The call is synchronous — the 200 response returns the finished 5-second video at body.url (a public .mp4 blob URL). Read body.url to fetch/download the generated video; body.model (veo3-fast) and body.duration confirm the result. No auth, no polling, no template params.

entries.name: Mimetic Short-Form Video
entries.description: Mimetic — short-form video generation.

usage.callShape: GET https://trymimetic.com/x402/create-video?prompt=<text>&aspect_ratio=9:16&duration=15 (x402 payment of 10 USDC on Base eip155:8453)
usage.outputShape: body.job_id, body.token (Bearer for status endpoint), body.status_url, body.status (processing|completed|failed), body.video_url (when status=completed)
quirks: Price is $10.00 (10 USDC, amount 10000000) on Base eip155:8453 — exceeds the QA $6 per-call ceiling, so it was NOT paid/tested (over-cap).
GET with query params; required param is prompt. Optional aspect_ratio (9:16|16:9|1:1|4:3|3:4, default 9:16) and duration (5|10|15 sec, default 15).
Async: response returns job_id + status_url + a Bearer token; poll status_url with header Authorization: Bearer <token> until status=completed, then read video_url.
402 pre-flight (probe) shows payable:true, but that only means the quote is fetchable — the endpoint was never actually paid, so async/output behavior is documented from schema only, not verified.
usage.guide: Call GET https://trymimetic.com/x402/create-video with query params: prompt (required), optionally aspect_ratio (default 9:16) and duration (default 15s). Pay the x402 quote of 10 USDC on Base. The response is an async job returning job_id, a Bearer token, and a status_url. Poll status_url with header Authorization: Bearer <token> until status is "completed", then download the video from video_url. Note this endpoint costs $10/call which is above the QA $6 ceiling, so it was not actually paid or verified — treat the async/output shape as schema-derived, not confirmed.

The registry spec's CALL url (https://amn-animations-0xbuildr.replit.app/api/generate) diverges from the task summary url (https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations), and the auto-mode payment classifier denied the real-USDC test because of that mismatch (it flagged paying a replit.app target that disagrees with the stated blockrun.ai endpoint).
